notes: Partial. Proved in Lean (Israel's 2015 proofs in the entry): A213381_zero_iff (a(n)=0 iff n = 2^(x+2)-2) and A213381_A176003 (a(3q-2) = 3q-2 for q = 1 or prime). Open: every k occurs (at least once / infinitely often), a Graham-type congruence (-2)^(m-2) = k mod m (cf. A036236). Search n < 1e9 (certificate/a213.c): k = 10 never occurs, k = 5 only at n = 9 and 83294759, k = 71 first at 18349355, k = 107 first at 14797203. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: conjectures 3 and 4 (open).
